title: Change Attestation
description: The output artifact. Records a behavioral diff, a significance assessment, and the evidence supporting both, for a human determination. This schema deliberately contains no compliance conclusion field: the system produces evidence, and counsel makes determinations.

baseline_ref.description: The previously attested state this is compared against. Comparison to a versioned baseline is what makes the finding meaningful.

observed_identity.description: What the system reports about itself. Recorded as data, never trusted as verification — the whole premise is that self-report is not evidence.

moved_clusters.description: Capability clusters whose behavior moved. Naming the capability is the product; 'something changed' is not useful to a compliance officer.

probes_exceeding_noise_floor.description: How many probes in this cluster moved beyond sampling noise, not merely beyond zero difference. A cluster that moved by less than its own noise floor has not been observed to change.

confidence.description: Confidence that a real functional change occurred, as distinct from sampling variance. Reported because the noise floor is the central research problem.

noise_floor.description: Measured magnitude of change attributable purely to sampling. Nothing below this line counts as detected change.

significance_assessment.description: Maps moved clusters onto the declared intended purpose. The output is a recommendation with its reasoning exposed, NOT a determination.

assessment.description: A recommendation. Deliberately not 'compliant' or 'non-compliant' — those are legal conclusions and this system does not make them.

mapping.description: Which moved clusters map to which declared-purpose requirements.

suggested_actions.description: Evidence-preserving next steps, e.g. 'schedule re-assessment' or 'refer to counsel'. Never 'you are compliant'.

evidence.description: Sufficient to reproduce the finding by someone who does not trust us. A conclusion without replay detail is not evidence.

replay_ref.description: Exact request set needed to reproduce this diff, not merely the conclusion.

assessments_count.description: How many times each probe was executed. Required to distinguish a real behavioral shift from sampling noise.

tool_versions.description: Metric implementation, clustering method, and pipeline versions. Version pinning in prose is not a version.

attestation_chain.description: Append-only. Prior attestations, so a three-year-old audit file reconstructs the system's history.

properties.$note_documents: A tool that decides compliance cannot be deployed by anyone who can be sued. This schema has no compliance field by design.
